nav_selector: #content-nav (probe harness element serializing queryCollectionNavigation("content") into the generated /navtree page; the official content starter template renders NO navigation element of its own)
actual_rule_observed: A page with frontmatter navigation: false (boolean) is excluded from the navigation tree; the remaining items kept their baseline positions (about at 0, index at 1).
notes: The measured effect of the flag is on the navigation tree only. A control generate with an unlinked VISIBLE page (content/control-visible.md, no navigation key) showed it was likewise not prerendered to .output/public/, proving that unlinked [...slug] catch-all routes are simply not auto-prerendered by nitro link-crawling — this is unrelated to navigation:false. matched_documented_rule is false because the official docs page could not be loaded in this environment to verify the documented hide flag (see rule.json/searches.json); the observed exclusion matches the widely documented `navigation: false` convention.
